regime_context: Detector shows Semiconductors as the narrow market leader (breadth 0.18, durability 0.51) with negative short-term return, while Innovative Pharma & CXO displays a broad, durable uptrend (breadth 0.86, durability 0.83) but is crowded. The absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically in China A-shares, so any trend allocation is experimental. Momentum rank is not predictive; cross-sectional IC ~0.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics as a potential challenger to Semiconductors: if Semiconductors breadth remains below 0.2 and AI Compute durability rises above 0.55 while its breadth expands, a leadership handoff could be in progress. Kill criterion: Semiconductors breadth recovers above 0.3 or AI Compute durability drops below 0.4.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO shows the strongest trend health among eligible themes: durability_bar 0.83 (trend), breadth 0.86, and it passed the absolute-trend gate. Despite crowding (z=1.21), crowding is a sizing caution not a fade signal. The overweight leans on trend continuation contingent on these health metrics holding.
evidence: durability_bar=0.83 and hurst_tag='trend' indicate a stable trend
breadth=0.857 suggests broad participation, not a narrow leader
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.21) means positioning is stretched; any external shock or profit-taking could trigger a sharp mean reversion. Additionally, dominance of AI-tech macro narratives may divert flows away from healthcare.

falsifier.text: Durability_bar falls below 0.6 or breadth drops below 0.5 within the next 20 trading days, indicating trend decay.
